b69fa6e4c9.q: What is AlexSandra Sisler's Own Your Seat movement and what does EmpowerServe offer?
b69fa6e4c9.a: Own Your Seat is a movement and platform bringing together leadership development, retail strategy, and customer experience. Through it, Sisler wants women to recognize their value, own their contributions and have a voice in decisions shaping their futures. EmpowerServe is the company platform that houses this work, and Sisler is currently writing a book on Own Your Seat to continue the message beyond traditional self-help into practical direction for people pursuing opportunities.

07b4f4123a.q: What is the snowballing team development technique AlexSandra Sisler recommends for building clinic culture?
07b4f4123a.a: Snowballing consists of short 15-minute shadowing opportunities across departments where employees follow colleagues to understand their roles—for example, an NP following a patient coordinator or an MA following the billing specialist. These carved-out shadowing periods naturally create higher emotional intelligence within the clinic or practice.

af723fcafb.q: Why do practice managers fail by working behind closed doors instead of on the clinic floor?
af723fcafb.a: When managers spend their days behind closed doors, they lose connection with the patient journey and cannot manage the patient experience. Managers need to be on the floor every 15 minutes to two hours, observing phones, checkout, retail, and employee interactions—greeting patients, stepping into treatment rooms, and truly leading. Without this visibility and involvement, they make decisions about parts of the business they don't understand.
